name: Circular Dish with Angled Side Walls and Decoration of Two Fish in a Lotus Pond
summary: This circular dish has steeply angled side walls that rise from the circular, flat base. The dish was potted over a hump mold placed at the center of the potter's wheel. The mold set the dish's profile and its diameter just as it also transferred its decoration; with his hands, the potter determined the thickness of the walls and finished its exterior.
